name: audi_tt_carla
notes: Size from CARLA's bounding box. Steering identified from about 150 000 samples of benchmark laps (scripts/identify_steering.py): full command gives about 30 deg at 4 m/s and 11 deg at 18 m/s. CARLA lists a 70 deg front-wheel limit, but that is not what the car achieves while driving.
